Package com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd

Interface StartingStatusProvider

All Superinterfaces:
StatusProvider
All Known Implementing Classes:
ApplicationContextStatusProvider, ApplicationRunStatusProvider, FlywayStatusProvider, LiquibaseStatusProvider
public interface StartingStatusProvider extends StatusProvider
Marks a StatusProvider that reports while the application starts up. Its status is only asked for until the application is ready, with Systemd.ready(), or until it is stopping, with Systemd.stopping(), if it stops before it is ready.

A status provider that implements none of StartingStatusProvider, RunningStatusProvider and StoppingStatusProvider is asked for its status in every state of the application, as one that implements all of them; one that implements some of them is only asked for its status in those states. This leaves out the providers whose status means nothing in a state, or whose sources may no longer be available, such as health checks of external systems once the application is stopping, whose connections are being closed.

Author:
Joao Silva
